name: DeleteDocuments
documentation:
Command to delete documents from the search store based on a search query.

This command allows for bulk deletion of documents that match a specified {@link SearchQuery}, across one or more collections. The deletion respects the provided {@link Guarantee}.

fields.name: batchSize
fields.documentation:
Controls how many matching documents the runtime deletes per statement. A value of {@code 0} uses the runtime
 default, a positive value requests that batch size, and a negative value requests a single unbounded statement.

fields.name: guarantee
fields.documentation: The delivery/storage guarantee to apply for this deletion operation.

fields.name: query
fields.documentation: The query describing which documents should be deleted.

constructors.name: DeleteDocuments
constructors.documentation: Creates a deletion command that uses the runtime's default batch size.
